text: At its meeting on March 28, 2023, the Toronto Parking Authority – Audit and Risk Management Committee considered Item PR1.1 and made recommendation to the Board of Directors of Toronto Parking Authority. Summary from the report (March 6, 2023) from the President, Toronto Parking Authority The purpose of this report is to establish the 2023 Work Plan for Audit and Risk Management Committee of the Board of Directors of Toronto Parking Authority.
The Board of Directors of Toronto Parking Authority received the report (March 6, 2023) from the President, Toronto Parking Authority, for information.
